description: Use this when a webhook should stop receiving events and be removed. Requires auth. Inputs: webhook_id (required). Returns {id, deleted:true}. This removes the hook. Fails with 404 webhook_not_found when the id is missing or belongs to another account.
name: cooper_delete_webhook

deleted.description: True when the object was deleted.

id.description: Stable id of the returned object. Pass it to the matching get, update, or delete tool.

title: Delete webhook
